in_sanskrit.name: Shibin
in_sanskrit.meaning: हिन्दू नाम जिसका अर्थ है God of Prosperity
in_sanskrit.long_meaning: Shibin एक संस्कृत नाम है जो हिंदू संस्कृति में गहरा आध्यात्मिक महत्व रखता है। Shibi is a Sanskrit name derived from the Hindu God Shiva. Shiva is the supreme God of the Hindu trinity, representing creation, preservation, and destruction. Shibin is a name that signifies the prosperity and abundance bestowed by this powerful deity.
